belief_force_USA.ambiguity: The CIA estimates of 1957 to 1961 give ranges for the projected Soviet intercontinental force (a low and a high case); on the count scale of decision 7g the window is the set of the bands from the estimate's low to its high projection for the date it projects for, read on the same count as the canonical row (ICBM launchers, heavy bombers and tankers, SLBM launchers where the estimate counts missile submarines; D9). The reading (the projected force) is fixed by decision 7d; what is set-valued is the projection, not the reading; the hindsight truth (count_USSR) is not in question. Built 2026-10-29 from the final replay coding (commit 1663c43 and cw_v1's first sight); candidate 4 of docs/ambiguous_levels.md section 8; owner's decision 7j. 1961 (NIE 11-8-60 of 1 Aug 1960, for mid-1963): the estimate's three illustrative programs 'represent the range of judgments' (Conclusion 5; paras. 33 to 40): operational ICBM launchers for mid-1963 200 (program C, para. 40), 400 (program A, para. 33, the DCI's) and 700 (program B, para. 36, USAF's); 130 heavy bombers and tankers for mid-1963 (Conclusion 12 table; USAF's higher footnote not used); missile submarines for mid-1963 4 Z (two missiles each), 18 G (about six) and 6 nuclear (6 to 12): 152 to 188 SLBM launchers. Low 482 (program C, 6 per nuclear boat; 330 without the submarines; under_1000), high 1,018 (program B, 12 per nuclear boat; over_1000; 1,000 at the midpoint of 6 to 12, 982 at 6, so the high member sits at the band's edge). The canonical member is the canonical row (under_1000, about 700 on program A).
